decision.reason: [ev-4ff4285f6d72] is a one-line changelog entry. It names the subject (Azure workload identity support for Microsoft Entra SSO) and says it was added. It does not say how the feature is turned on or configured: no config key, ConfigMap field, Helm value or component is named. It also does not say whether it is opt-in or changes how existing Entra SSO setups behave, so the applicability condition can't be written. To decide, we need the upgrade guide, docs or PR #21433 content stating the configuration surface and default behaviour.
